newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha in bearish trend on weak fundamentals.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha in bearish trend on weak fundamentals.

text.p: NWE naphtha markets extended their recent bear trend with a combination of prompt oversupply, a weakening crack spread to crude and cheaper alternative feedstocks keeping buyers relaxed.
"We'll need to see quite a bit of oil going out of this market before things start to pick up again," a trader said.
He said arbitrage to the East was workable but there was little chance of taking the surplus oil transatlantic.
Prompt cargoes were notionally pegged around the $190 a tonne level with no buyers seen. April paper was in contango by around $1 per tonne.
Traders said cargo holders were keen to sell into the early March market for fear the contango would widen further with end March demand expected to be minimal.
